aggregate_only_checked: per-individual tenure-exclusion counts, whose excluded rows are outside the released analytic set
frame alpha bootstrap confidence intervals as published (own resampling scheme agrees to within the registered tolerance)
H3 lagged-vote, leadership and tenure covariate extensions
independently_recomputed: active-seat mandate gate, interval overlap and published cessation/resumption boundaries
exact-title cross-outlet duplication and its all-copy exclusion sensitivity
frame inter-model agreement and majority-vote reconstruction
human audit agreement, weighted task metrics and group-context bias
not_reconstructed_from_release: crawler recall and mention-extraction attrition, which need the upstream crawl logs
standalone Cointet hyperlink placement, whose hyperlink graph is not ours to redistribute
FrIdeo source-model fitting and its placement uncertainty, which need the source corpus
any label re-derivation from headline text, which is withheld for copyright

cross_outlet_duplicates.definition: verbatim identical title strings appearing at two or more outlets; paraphrased syndication is not measured

conflict.eligible_panel: fixed once on the observed data at the per-side floor of 20; identical in every draw

economic.eligible_panel: fixed once on the observed data at the per-side floor of 20; identical in every draw

human_interest.eligible_panel: fixed once on the observed data at the per-side floor of 20; identical in every draw

morality.eligible_panel: fixed once on the observed data at the per-side floor of 20; identical in every draw

responsibility.eligible_panel: fixed once on the observed data at the per-side floor of 20; identical in every draw

tone_conflict_coupling.test: two-sided Spearman rank correlation between each outlet's tone asymmetry and its conflict-prevalence asymmetry; p_value is SciPy's parametric reference against zero rank correlation, NOT a permutation result

mandate_gate.source: Assemblee nationale, base Sycomore; one fiche per roster member, retrieved 2026-09-13

primary_gradient_fixed_panel_article_boo.eligible_panel: fixed once on the observed data at the per-side floor of 20; identical in every draw

article_clustered_bootstrap.eligible_panel: re-applied within each draw: an outlet enters a replicate only if that replicate gives it at least 20 left-bloc and 20 right-bloc mentions, so the panel can differ between draws

clustered_pooled_gap.estimator: OLS signed tone on intercept and left-bloc indicator

design.human_inputs: headline and target MP name; no parliamentary group or bloc
design.model_inputs: headline, target MP name, and parliamentary group
design.weighting: inverse probability by model sentiment x dominant frame

propagation.scope: The benchmark bounds differential model error against coders blinded to group; it is not a causal reannotation of the same model with group removed.

conflict_error_propagation.interpretation: Nondifferential error adjustment is affine within each party, so H3 ranks are unchanged; target-side-specific adjustment can change outlet asymmetry ordering.

joint_placement_uncertainty.estimand: Spearman correlation in the fixed 25-outlet observed panel

interpretation.analytic: Independent normal draws from released outlet score and sigma; marginal-error approximation because analytic cross-outlet covariance is unavailable.
interpretation.membership: Fixed; no outlet resampling because inference is scoped to the observed purposive panel.
interpretation.model_perturbation: Joint released FrIdeo perturbation of family evidence and shrinkage, including shared panel re-standardisation.

multiplicity.family_definition: Three central cross-outlet ideology-gradient claims in Results: directed tone, conflict framing, and morality framing.
multiplicity.method: Holm-Bonferroni, two-sided raw Spearman p-values, familywise alpha 0.05
nominal_exploratory_outputs: leave-one-out, alternate-label, scale-ablation, capture, and placement sensitivities
all MP-level rank, temporal, lagged, subgroup, covariate-adjusted, beta-binomial, and headline-binomial tests
multiplicity.selection_timing: Defined during the 2026-08-31 revision; not preregistered and therefore descriptive rather than confirmatory.

acquisition.deduplication: database unique (outlet_id,norm_url); extraction unique (article_id,target_uid); syndicated cross-outlet publication retained

capture_diagnostics.limitation: Database volume is a continuity diagnostic, not a denominator of all articles actually published; source-side capture recall is not directly observed.
capture_diagnostics.low_volume_definition: interior month <50% of that outlet's 2024-08--2026-05 monthly median

excluded.Fdesouche: aggregator rather than an original newsroom
excluded.Le Canard Encha\u00een\u00e9: not in the independently defined FrIdéo outlet universe
